stopped_because: ran the 5 iterations it was given

fields.name: target_containers
fields.description: Ordered list of the positions of the containers that the goal asks for, in goal order (first the container hiding the first named cube, then the one hiding the next named cube, if any). Each position is the demonstration position of the container that came down over that cube, i.e. the container whose coordinates lie within a few pixels of where that cube was before the containers appeared. Filled in at the first decision step from the demonstration steps and never changed afterwards. e.g. [[81, 95], [66, 143]]

fields.name: picks_done
fields.description: Number of target containers the robot has picked up so far in this episode. 0 at the first decision step. Increases by one at the first decision step whose execution steps show the robot having closed its fingers on a container and lifted it (fingers partly closed, around 40-60% open, gripper raised); stays the same at steps that show a put-down or no grasp. e.g. 1
